sloka: अथवा मोचयिष्यामि त्वामद्यैव वरानने ।अस्माद्दुःखादुपारोह मम पृष्ठमनिन्दिते ।। ५.३७.१९।।।।
transliteration: athavā mocayiṣyāmi tvāmadyaiva varānane ।asmādduḥkhādupāroha mama pṛṣṭhamanindite ।। 5.37.19।।।।

translations.english: "O beautiful lady, if you please, I shall redeem you today itself from grief. You may ride on my back, O blameless lady.
